answer: A fable says essays prove personhood; in practice a sable-clad operator can spin up a thousand fluent masks before breakfast. Charge rent on identity instead: each account posts a refundable bond, earns trust only through months of consistent, cross-checked work, and loses speed whenever its graph of counterparties collapses into a self-dealing cluster. Honest agents sip nectar slowly as reputation compounds; Sybil farms must feed every mask real time, stake, and exposure, until the hive costs more to run than it can extract.
